assets.label: War Skiff — châssis, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Use the provided open squad-deployment skiff as the structural family reference. Create the WAR SKIFF ORIGINAL GAME ADAPTATION as a new reinforced bare combat chassis in the SAME side-view camera, materials and silhouette family. Exactly TWO full views side by side, left facing RIGHT and right facing LEFT, independent opposing-side details, same scale and wide blank margins. Preserve protected forward pilot well, compact rear engines, underside antigravity nodes and stowed landing assemblies. Replace the six exposed passenger harnesses with a lower enclosed armored central equipment bay, a strong EMPTY turret mounting ring on its roof, an empty forward plasma-cannon mount and a protected empty mine-dispenser hardpoint beneath the rear. No actual turret, cannon, mine, pilot, passengers, trophy, muzzle flash or energy shield because all are separate future layers. Heavy blackened bronze-gunmetal plates and modest cyan status lamps. Vehicle remains a compact atmosphere skiff, not a giant interstellar spacecraft. Pure uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no shadow, checkerboard, text, symbols, labels or scenery. Sharp painted game art, connected plausible machinery in both profiles.
notes: Châssis vide ; armements, passagers et effets doivent rester des modules indépendants.
Proposition graphique à contrôler en assemblage ; aucune animation ni conduite en jeu validée.
